name: Clocinnamox
summary: Clocinnamox (CCAM or C-CAM; developmental code name NIH-10443) is a selective and irreversible antagonist of the μ-opioid receptor. Closely related compounds include methocinnamox (MCAM) and methoclocinnamox (MCCAM). They were derived via structural modification of buprenorphine. Clocinnamox was first described in the scientific literature by 1992.

pharmacology.text: Clocinnamox (CCAM or C-CAM; developmental code name NIH-10443) is a selective and irreversible antagonist of the μ-opioid receptor.

uses.en: It is a laboratory research tool used to block mu opioid receptors for long periods in animal studies.
uses.zh: 它是實驗室研究工具，用於動物研究中長時間阻斷 μ 鴉片類受體。
uses.zhHans: 它是实验室研究工具，用于动物研究中长时间阻断 μ 鸦片类受体。

fact.en: Clocinnamox and its sister compound methocinnamox were made by modifying buprenorphine. Methocinnamox is now being studied as a long-lasting way to protect against opioid overdose.
fact.zh: Clocinnamox 與其姊妹化合物 methocinnamox 是改造丁基原啡因而來的。methocinnamox 目前正被研究作為預防鴉片類藥物過量的長效方法。
fact.zhHans: Clocinnamox 与其姊妹化合物 methocinnamox 是改造丁基原啡因而来的。methocinnamox 目前正被研究作为预防鸦片类药物过量的长效方法。
